logic_errors.title: Authenticated physical begin with a null ID output silently preserves false exactness
logic_errors.description: The !id early return skips authentication, counting, and the sticky loss fence. The public header does not declare a non-null ID precondition. Under the documented once-per-accepted-physical-dispatch contract, an authenticated duplicate passed with id=NULL returns UNTRACKED but leaves an earlier row exact=true and count_known=true with physical_count=1. Other unrecordable authenticated ingress paths correctly poison the generation. This is a library fail-closed defect on caller misuse, not a demonstrated remote exploit; the supplied fixture always supplies a valid output pointer.
reproduction: Create fixture ledger; use the same five valid opaque tokens and Bearer synthetic-not-a-secret throughout.
begin(l,auth,&h,1,&first) returns TRACKED; finish(first,true,2); source_complete(l,auth,&h,2); get(first,2) returns count=1, count_known=true, exact=true.
get(l,auth,&h,first,3,&view) still returns count=1, count_known=true, exact=true.
logic_errors.expected: An authenticated accepted dispatch that cannot be retained must revoke count certainty/exactness for the generation, including previously exact rows.
logic_errors.recommended_fix: For an enabled ledger, authenticate before handling a missing output pointer; on an authenticated missing-output begin call mark loss before returning UNTRACKED. Keep unauthorized calls state-neutral. Add a regression covering both authenticated-null and unauthorized-null output cases.

suggestions.description: The module docstring names run_hermes_physical_probe.sh rather than run_hermes_ingress_probe.sh.

Record and assert the three request stream booleans explicitly (true,false,true), so the streaming-503/nonstreaming-reissue/next-streaming description is directly enforced by this proof, rather than inferred from pinned Hermes behavior.
Promote the independent per-axis full-key source mismatch and unauthorized large-timestamp checks into durable unit cases.

normal_ctest.command: cmake -S . -B build-attempts -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build-attempts -j 4 && ctest --test-dir build-attempts --output-on-failure

sanitizer_ctest.command: cmake -S . -B build-attempts-san -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DRECURSANT_SANITIZERS=ON && cmake --build build-attempts-san -j 4 && ctest --test-dir build-attempts-san --output-on-failure
sanitizer_ctest.scope: New ledger and white-box overflow targets explicitly instrumented with ASan+UBSan; not a claim that every pre-existing target is fully instrumented.

hermes_runtime.isolation: Existing image, --pull never, --network none, owning UID:GID, read-only root, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, tmpfs HOME/HERMES_HOME, scoped read-only fixture/adapter/library mounts, no host profile or credentials.

additional_independent_checks: unauthorized begin/source/get do not poison clock/count
static_assessment: Ledger namespace is the immutable borrowed auth table and project index; client project headers cannot change it.
All five opaque fields are matched exactly and case sensitively; names are case insensitive and duplicate headers invalid.
Boot entropy plus monotonically increasing serial gives generation-separated physical handles, with explicit exhaustion fail-closed.
Duplicates revoke previous eligibility; expiry is exclusive; permanent tombstones prevent same-generation replay resurrection.
Capacity, malformed identity, backwards time, TTL arithmetic overflow, and explicit loss fence exactness, except the null-ID output path reported above.
Source completion is a trusted internal API requiring the identical authenticated full key, not a public complete=true input. This library is not source attestation.
Production router source is unchanged between base and reviewed commit.
evidence_limits: No production router integration or full M3 acceptance is claimed or granted.
Datagrams are drained after the workflow; live authenticated ingest and source-before-next-dispatch are unproved and explicitly deferred.
Cross-restart source replay admission, boot/task lifecycle validation, and atomic selection re-query remain integration responsibilities.
The scripted provider is not inference, quality, token-cost or savings evidence.
Historical RED/TDD chronology was read as supplied evidence, not independently re-executed at intermediate revisions.
